root.label: span and mdspan
root.note: Non-owning views over contiguous data, one-dimensional and multidimensional.

children.label: span basics
children.note: A pointer and a length that works as a range.

children.label: Non-owning
children.note: It never allocates or frees, so it dangles if the owner dies or reallocates.

children.label: Borrowed range
children.note: Iterators into a span remain valid after the span object is gone.

children.label: Deduction from source
children.note: span s(arr) gives a static extent; span s(vec) gives a dynamic one.

children.label: Extent
children.note: Fixed in the type or stored at run time.

children.label: dynamic_extent
children.note: Length is stored in the object; the default.

children.label: Static extent
children.note: Length lives in the type, so the object can be a single pointer in practice.

children.label: Explicit conversions
children.note: Dynamic to static, and range to static, are explicit and have a size precondition.

children.label: Constness
children.note: The element type decides, not the span.

children.label: Shallow const
children.note: const span<int> still lets you write the elements.

children.label: span of const
children.note: span<const int> is read-only and accepts const containers.

children.label: Rvalue ranges
children.note: Only span<const T> may be built from an rvalue range; the result dangles.

children.label: Slicing preconditions
children.note: Out-of-range slices are undefined, not exceptions.

children.label: first, last, subspan
children.note: Each needs its count or offset within size(); offset == size() is valid.

children.label: Template forms
children.note: first<N>() and friends always return a static extent.

children.label: C++26 hardening
children.note: Hardened implementations check these preconditions; plain builds may not.

children.label: Bytes view
children.note: Object representation as bytes.

children.label: as_bytes
children.note: Returns span<const byte> over the same memory.

children.label: as_writable_bytes
children.note: Needs a non-const element type.

children.label: mdspan (C++23)
children.note: A non-owning multidimensional view with policies.

children.label: Extents
children.note: Static and dynamic dimensions, plus an index type; dextents is all dynamic.

children.label: Layout policy
children.note: layout_right is row-major and the default; layout_left and layout_stride exist too.

children.label: Accessor policy
children.note: Controls element access; default_accessor returns a plain reference.

children.label: m[i, j] subscript
children.note: Multidimensional operator[]; the index count must equal the rank.

children.label: submdspan (C++26)
children.note: Slices rows, columns and blocks; supported by g++-16 in C++26 mode, not libc++ 21.
